tagline: Play together with friends, from the couch.
home_join_sub: Use their code, or join a game on this network
home_host_sub: See who wants to join, share your invite, change the switches
pick_title_guest: Which computer is your friend's game on?
pick_title_host: Which computer runs PS5Upload for this PS5?
pick_looking: Looking for PS5Upload on this network…
pick_none: No PS5Upload found yet. Make sure PS5Upload is open on the computer, and that "PS5Upload Play can find this computer" is on in PS5Upload › Settings › Play Together. You can also type its address.
pick_tailnet_fail: Couldn't reach %s over Tailscale (%s). Is Tailscale on in PS5Upload › Settings?
way_code_sub: Your friend reads it out from PS5Upload › Play Together
way_nearby: Ask to join without a code
way_nearby_sub: Works when one Play Together is open on that computer
code_help: Six letters and numbers, like KMX-4R7. Your friend sees it in PS5Upload › Play Together.
addr_help: PS5Upload shows it on its Play Together screen. Add :port if it is not 19113.
addr_bad: That doesn't look like an address. Use numbers and dots, like 192.168.1.20.
st_asking: Waiting for your friend to let you in…
st_asking_sub: They see your request in PS5Upload and on their TV.
st_waiting: Your friend is starting their game again…
why_key: That code didn't work. Check it with your friend and try again.
why_expired: That invite has run out. Ask your friend for a new code.
why_full: The game is full right now.
why_denied: Your friend said no this time.
why_no_answer: Your friend didn't answer in time.
why_closed: Play Together isn't open on that computer right now.
why_not_playing: Your friend isn't playing right now. They start Remote Play in PS5Upload first.
why_old_helper: Your friend's PS5 needs a newer PS5Upload helper. They can update it in PS5Upload.
why_unreachable_ps5: PS5Upload couldn't reach your friend's PS5.
why_slow_down: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute, then try again.
why_seat_taken: Your friend needed that controller back. Join again to get your own.
why_hello: PS5Upload didn't understand this app. Update PS5Upload Play.
fail_unreachable: Couldn't reach PS5Upload at %s. Is it open, and on the same network as this PS5?
fail_busy: PS5Upload is busy. Try again in a minute.
fail_old_engine: That PS5Upload is too old for PS5Upload Play. Update PS5Upload on that computer.
end_kicked: Your friend took you out of the game.
end_replaced: You joined from somewhere else, so this one stopped.
end_lost: The connection to your friend's game was lost.
end_seat_taken: Your friend needed their controller back, and no other spot was free.
play_hint_ps: Hold OPTIONS + TOUCHPAD: your friend's PS button
play_hint_leave: Hold L1 + R1 + OPTIONS + TOUCHPAD: leave
play_hold_ps: Keep holding: your friend's PS button
play_ps_sent: PS button pressed on your friend's PS5
play_move_first: Move to your own user before pressing ✕ (not %s).
play_move_first_plain: Move to your own user before pressing ✕.
play_codec_hevc: Your friend's stream uses a picture format this PS5 can't show. They can pick H.264 in PS5Upload › Play.
play_codec_main10: Your friend streams in HDR, which this app can't show yet. They can turn HDR off in PS5Upload › Play.
play_took_host: Your friend's stream ended: the user picked on the TV may have been theirs.
host_pair_text: PS5Upload Play needs your OK once before it can show and change Play Together from here.
host_pair_code_text: On your computer, open PS5Upload › Play › Play Together › Pair PS5Upload Play and type this code.
host_pair_gone: The code ran out. Show a new one.
host_auth_dropped: PS5Upload no longer knows this PS5's pairing. Pair again.
host_old_engine: This PS5Upload doesn't know PS5Upload Play yet. Update PS5Upload on that computer.
host_idle: Not streaming. Start Remote Play in PS5Upload › Play to play together.
host_rp_ready: Remote Play is set up on %s.
host_rp_setup: Set up Remote Play in PS5Upload › Play › Set up Play.
host_helper_on: The PS5Upload helper is running on this PS5.
host_helper_off: PS5Upload's helper isn't running here (or is older): start it from PS5Upload.
host_rp_on_here: Remote Play is on for this PS5.
host_rp_off_here: Remote Play is off on this PS5.
host_rp_user_here: This PS5 user hasn't allowed Remote Play yet.
host_rp_account: This PS5's account isn't set up for Remote Play yet: use PS5Upload › Play › Set up Play.
host_rp_enable_confirm: Press ✕ again to turn on Remote Play
host_rp_enable_failed: Remote Play didn't turn on (%s). Use PS5Upload › Play › Set up Play.
host_rp_pin_text: Type it in PS5Upload › Play › Set up Play. %d:%02d left.
host_rp_pin_paired: Paired: PS5Upload can start Remote Play with this PS5 now.
host_rp_pin_failed: That PIN didn't work (%s). Show a new one.
host_together_wait: Friends can join once you play. Start Remote Play in PS5Upload › Play.
host_works_wifi: Scan to join on this Wi-Fi
host_sw_block: Keep PS and Create to myself
host_sw_seat: A friend may use my stream's controller
host_wake_note: To wake this PS5 from rest, use PS5Upload › Settings › This PS5.
host_game_note: While a game runs this app is closed by the PS5; join requests then show on the TV.
about_music: Music: an original piece made for PS5Upload Play.
